needsReview.note: GET /users/me/profile was read for name/email/phone but holds none of them (patient record); identity now comes from GET /auth/me. The medical card still shows booleans as 'No' when the server only has defaults, and the blood type key does not match /medical-profile (blood_type).
the board has a 'saved cards' row; there is no web screen or endpoint for it, not drawn.
the server fields (profile_visible, share_data) do not match the five keys the BFF sends (shareData, analytics, location...); a missing field falls back to a made-up default.
the sessions list has no 'current session' flag, so ending the session in use signs the patient out at the next refresh; session ids now reach the client (parseOwnSessions), reviewer to confirm.
status codes of support requests are shown as the server sends them (untranslated); no list of codes to translate.
the form sends a fixed amount per service type (250, 120, 80, 80) that no server data supports; the backend should price the return from the order.
the OpenStreetMap embed is blocked by the CSP (frame-src has no openstreetmap.org); the pane only shows once the owner allows the host.
the first agent bubble is a local greeting, not a server message; the old 'online, replies within a minute' claim was removed.
GET /patient-ux/reviews is a partial route with no reviewer name or target shown; only stars and comment exist.

the selects call the API origin from the browser (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL) instead of the web proxy; names exist in Arabic and English only. Runtime check: with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL unset the call goes to https://api.nabd.plus (ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID in the sandbox, the only console error of the batch); the patient proxy allowlist has no /locations routes.
the server also publishes a half-refund tier (half_hours, half_refund_percent) that the app terms do not mention; only full_hours and late_fee_percent are written.
